capabilities: sync saved Clippings clips into the vault as Markdown notes with transcripts, takeaways and properties
connect a vault to a Clippings account through browser sign-in
configure base folder, grouping (platform, creator, date) and filename templates
edit the note template and choose how existing notes are handled
sync automatically on open, on a timer, or on demand
extras: Free accounts are limited to 5 synced clips then one per week; paid plans lift the limit. A 10% discount code (OBSIDIAN10) is offered. Development section explains symlink setup with the Hot Reload plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no way to ingest transcripts, slide text and takeaways from videos you save on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram or X without manually copying them.

relations.evidence: This plugin is the Obsidian half of that.

summary: Official sync client for the Clippings service that pulls saved short-video clips, transcripts and AI takeaways into the vault as templated Markdown notes.
